mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category_orders (user_id, category_id, is_custom, type, sort_order) SELECT #{userId}, category_id, 0, type, sort_order FROM categories WHERE type = #{type} AND is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT co.category_id as categoryId, CASE WHEN co.is_custom = 1 THEN cc.name ELSE c.name END as name, co.type, co.is_custom as isCustom, co.sort_order as sortOrder FROM category_orders co LEFT JOIN categories c ON co.category_id = c.category_id AND co.is_custom = 0 LEFT JOIN custom_categories cc ON co.category_id = cc.custom_category_id AND co.is_custom = 1 WHERE co.user_id = #{userId} AND co.type = #{type} AND (co.is_custom = 1 OR c.is_active = 1) ORDER BY co.sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_categories (user_id, name, type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{type})

INSERT INTO category_orders (user_id, category_id, is_custom, type, sort_order) SELECT #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{isCustom}, #{type}, COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM category_orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = #{type}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM category_orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_custom = #{isCustom}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO category_orders (user_id, category_id, is_custom, type, sort_order) VALUES
(#{userId}, #{order.categoryId}, #{order.isCustom}, #{type}, #{order.sortOrder})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sort_order = VALUES(sort_order)
